phrases.latin: Quid hīc scrīptum est? Lege mihi.
phrases.english: What does it say here? Read it to me.

phrases.latin: Quid istīc scrīptum? — Juxtā tēcum, sī tū nescīs, nesciō.
phrases.english: What does it say in there? — I know as much as you: if you don’t know, I don’t.

phrases.latin: An, opsecrō hercle, habent quās gallīnae manūs? nam hās quidem gallīna scrīpsit.
phrases.english: Good heavens, do hens have hands? Because a hen certainly wrote this.

sources: Lewis & Short: lego
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 31.
